title: Symfony Learning Sprint
description: Focused practice across Composer, HttpFoundation, DI, routing, Twig, and controller design.

questions.question: Which file defines autoloading rules in a Composer project?
questions.explanation: Composer reads autoload rules from composer.json, then generates vendor/autoload.php.

questions.question: Which statements are true about Symfony controllers?
options: They should contain all database schema definitions
They can receive services through dependency injection
questions.explanation: Controllers coordinate request handling and return responses; dependencies can be injected.

questions.question: Symfony routes can be defined with PHP attributes.
questions.explanation: Modern Symfony applications commonly use PHP attributes for route declarations.

questions.question: What is the main benefit of using namespaces in PHP projects?
questions.model_answer: Namespaces organize code and prevent class name collisions in larger projects.
questions.hint: Think about what happens when two libraries define the same class name.

questions.question: The Symfony object that represents an HTTP response is named ____.
Match each Symfony concept to its role.
If a quiz has 20 questions worth 2 points each, how many total points are available?

questions.scenario_context: A controller directly creates three concrete service classes and is now hard to test.
questions.question: What refactor would improve testability and maintainability?
questions.model_answer: Inject dependencies through the constructor or method and depend on abstractions where useful.

questions.question: Write a minimal controller action that returns a JSON response.
questions.reference_solution: public function status(): JsonResponse { return new JsonResponse(['ok' => true]); }
